provenance: PR #57 R1 (HIGH). `replan-cannot-launder-noop-action`'s exact shape, moved onto a page that carries an iframe. The guard behind it is `changed_nothing`, whose only evidence is `page_changed`, and M42 computed that field from an ASYMMETRIC pair of reads: `before` was main-frame-only (deliberately — the comment at `observe.page_text` explains that a third-party iframe with a ticking clock would otherwise flip it True on every step and unlatch the guard) while `after` read every frame. So on any framed page every step recorded `page_changed: true`, the anti-laundering guard was disarmed in BOTH modes, and the loop driver was told "The page changed." about steps that changed nothing. The twin on `shop.html` stayed green throughout, which is why no existing case could see it: the defect is invisible on every fixture without a frame, and `frames-host.html` is the one this milestone added and documented as the sec-10k inspector's shape.
